content.short: ORA is a verifiable AI oracle that brings complex machine learning and AI computation directly on-chain.
content.description: ORA Protocol is a pioneering verifiable AI oracle designed to enable decentralized applications to integrate artificial intelligence with cryptographic integrity. Utilizing its proprietary Optimistic Machine Learning (opML) technology, ORA achieves high-performance on-chain inference at a fraction of the cost of zero-knowledge alternatives. The platform's Onchain AI Oracle (OAO) allows smart contracts to trustlessly call advanced models like LLaMA 3. ORA also introduces the Initial Model Offering (IMO), tokenizing AI models using the ERC-7641 standard to capture revenue for creators.
